Health Gauge displays score 0-100 with color coding (green/amber/red)
KPI cards show: Devices Offline, Critical Tickets, SLA Breaches, Backups Failed, Security Alerts

macOS-style dots header (red, amber, green) present on terminal output panel

Module Templates return correct counts: 12 ticket, 4 onboarding, 4 SLA, 6 runbook, 8 script templates
Navigation has Morning Checks link under Service Desk section
